# CiteAura

> CiteAura is a Generative Engine Optimization platform that audits, measures, and improves brand citations, mentions, and visibility in generative AI engines, then closes the loop with engineering tickets and verification.

- [For Brands](https://citeaura.com/for-brands): AI visibility diagnosis, public-site fixes, and closed-loop verification.
- [Methodology](https://citeaura.com/methodology): Evidence model, sampling modes, cohorts, and verification boundaries.

## Key facts

- Canonical name: CiteAura
- Official website: https://citeaura.com
- Category: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) software
- Starter trial: 14 days
- Starter price: $79 / month for 3 active projects
- Typical API sampling cost: under 1 percent of one Starter month
- Priority ticket windows: 30 days or 60 days
- Key encryption: AES-256-GCM
- Updated: 2026-08-26

## Product workflow

- Step 1. Create a workspace and add a public website domain.
- Step 2. Audit crawlability, page structure, extractable facts, structured data, and authority signals.
- Step 3. Measure AI visibility with explicit provenance and sampling-mode labels.
- Step 4. Convert evidence into prioritized action tickets with acceptance criteria.
- Step 5. Re-crawl implemented changes and export diagnostic reports with explicit readiness states.

## Who it is for

- Independent creators and single brands
- Teams that need diagnosis, engineering tickets, and closed-loop verification
- Agencies that need white-label client delivery packs

## Who it is not for

- Teams that only want traditional search rankings and click reports
- Work without a public website that can be crawled

## Measurement integrity

- Sampling outputs retain one of these modes: API - Parametric knowledge, API - Search grounded, or Manual - Product interface.
- Unmeasured providers and insufficient sample coverage are disclosed rather than estimated.
- CiteAura does not guarantee AI mentions, rankings, citations, or optimization outcomes.

## Delivery readiness

- Diagnostic readiness, visibility readiness, and implementation readiness are evaluated independently.
- Assets marked as needing review require factual or editorial approval before publication.
- Templates and outlines are implementation inputs, not finished publishable pages.
